title: Kuala Lumpur · Genting and Fraser’s Hill
slogan: Tropical mountain bends and cool ridge air.
story: Tropical mountain bends and cool ridge air. 165 km round from Kampung Bukit Tinggi, Bentong - plan on about 3 h 10 of riding. The stops in between: Bentong and Kuala Kubu Bharu. The climbs: Genting Sempah and Fraser’s Hill road. The passes are the reason to go.

sections.advice: Kuala Lumpur start → Genting Sempah is the reward section in Kuala Lumpur. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.advice: This Bentong food → Fraser’s Hill road stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.
